map.面积公式（鞋带法）：A = ½|Σ(xᵢ·yᵢ₊₁ − xᵢ₊₁·yᵢ)|；周长: Area formula (Shoelace): A = ½|Σ(xᵢ·yᵢ₊₁ − xᵢ₊₁·yᵢ)|; perimeter is the sum of distances between adjacent vertices. Enter vertices in clockwise or counterclockwise order.
map.由多边形顶点坐标算面积与周长。: Compute area and perimeter from polygon vertex coordinates.
map.四顶点 (0,0)(100,0)(100,50)(0,50)：面积=½|Σ(xᵢ: Four vertices (0,0)(100,0)(100,50)(0,50): area = ½|Σ(xᵢyᵢ₊₁−xᵢ₊₁yᵢ)| = ½|5000| = 5000 m² = 7.5 mu, perimeter 300 m.
map.多顶点按顺序输入，公式对凸/凹多边形均适用，面积为绝对值，顶点顺序错会得负值取: Enter many vertices in order; the formula works for both convex and concave polygons; area is the absolute value, and a wrong vertex order yields a negative value whose abs is taken.
map.须按边界顺/逆时针连续排列、首尾相接，跳点会算错面积。: Vertices must follow the boundary continuously in clockwise or counterclockwise order, head to tail; skipping points miscomputes the area.
map.面积 m² ÷666.67=亩；国土常用，工程也用公顷(10000 m²)。: Area m² ÷ 666.67 = mu; common in land surveying, and hectares (10000 m²) are also used in engineering.
